I.RECYCLE WATER SYSTEM EXTENSION-HOLLIDAY PARK
PROJECT
II.PROJECT DESCRIPTION:
The project consists of an extension of the Recycle Water System to Holliday Park.
The project would require the construction of about 4,200 feet of 8"” pipeline and
about 2,500 feet of 4” pipeline. The project would irrigate about 28.5 acres of sod.
II.FINANCE:
The Holliday Park Recycle Water System Extension Project is estimated to cost
about $1 million and is included in the FY 2014 water enterprise fund budget.
IV.STATUS:
If approved, BOPU staff will submit an application to the State Loan and
Investment Board for project funding. Staff is requesting funding under the Green
Project Special Program by the State Loan and Investment which includes a25%
principal forgiveness($250,000)loan and a 75% zero percent (0%) interest loan
($750,000) to be repaid over twenty (20) years.The annual principal payment on
the proposed loan will be $37,500. That amount would be paid from revenue from
the water enterprise fund.
V.REQUEST AND RECOMMENDATION:
Staff recommends that the Board adopt the RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING
SUBMISSION OF AN APPLICATION TO THE WYOMING STATE LOAN
